title: Our brand values
slide_intent: Translate abstract values into behaviors people can recognize. The explanations let a team discuss what each value demands in practice.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can align teams around a shared ethos while giving each value a distinct behavioral meaning.
demonstration: Five labels on black identify Insightful, Challenging, Fast, Courageous and Solidarity. Each sits beside explanatory copy on a cyan field.
practical_value: Choose a behavior that fits a stated value and check it against the accompanying explanation.
